newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE HITS RECORD TRADE OF 146 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE HITS RECORD TRADE OF 146 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonia's bourse turned over a high of 146 million kroons on Wednesday, preliminary data showed.
The bullish post-midsummer session was pushed up by construction firm EMV, which saw about 76 million kroons of its shares traded.
The previous record for a single session was on March 20, when the bourse recorded trade of 114.656 million kroons, a spokesperson for the stock exchange told Reuters.
